2609.27470.title: DeltaS: Reading the Gated Linear Attention State for KV Cache Eviction in Streaming Video
2609.27470.paper_summary: Recent video-language models increasingly adopt hybrid architectures that interleave linear and full attention layers for efficient long-context processing. While the recurrent state of linear attention remains fixed in size, the KV cache of full attention continues to grow with the video stream, making eviction necessary under a bounded memory budget. The key challenge in streaming is that eviction must occur before the question arrives, so what to retain has to be decided without the question. Existing eviction methods derive token scores from the KV cache itself, using position, attention, or key-value representations, and attention-based scores further require proxy queries or extra computation. Hybrid backbones offer another source of signal. In gated-delta linear attention, the recurrent state is updated by the residual between each input and what can already be retrieved from the state, so its change over a chunk of frames reflects how much new information the chunk brings. We propose DeltaS, a query-agnostic, training-free method that retains video chunks inducing larger normalized state change, or state drift. In a controlled comparison with the budget and retention policy held fixed, state drift outperforms position-, attention-, and key-value-based signals. With a signal costing only 1.9% of the forward pass, DeltaS surpasses the strongest query-agnostic bounded-memory baseline by 2.1 points on average across six long-video benchmarks and by 5.6 points on the longest benchmark. These results suggest that the two memories of hybrid architectures can work cooperatively. Code is available at https://github.com/MaumAI-Company/DeltaS.
2609.27470.paper_summary_zh: 最近的視頻語言模型越來越多地採用混合架構，這些架構交錯使用線性和全注意力層，以實現高效的長上下文處理。雖然線性注意力的遞歸狀態保持固定大小，但全注意力的 KV 緩存隨著視頻流不斷增長，這使得在有限的內存預算下需要進行驅逐。流媒體中的主要挑戰是驅逐必須在問題到達之前進行，因此必須在沒有問題的情況下決定保留什麼。現有的驅逐方法從 KV 緩存本身推導出標記分數，使用位置、注意力或鍵值表示，基於注意力的分數進一步需要代理查詢或額外計算。混合骨幹提供了另一個信號來源。在門控增量線性注意力中，遞歸狀態通過每個輸入與從狀態中已經可以檢索到的內容之間的殘差進行更新，因此其在一段幀中的變化反映了該段帶來的新信息量。我們提出了 DeltaS，一種與查詢無關的、無需訓練的方法，該方法保留導致更大正規化狀態變化或狀態漂移的視頻片段。在固定預算和保留政策的控制比較中，狀態漂移的表現超過了基於位置、注意力和鍵值的信號。DeltaS 的信號成本僅為前向傳播的 1.9%，在六個長視頻基準測試中，平均超過最強的查詢無關有限內存基準 2.1 分，在最長的基準中超過 5.6 分。這些結果表明混合架構的兩種記憶可以協同工作。代碼可在 https://github.com/MaumAI-Company/DeltaS 獲得。
